risks.reason: The lessee must bear premises administration fees, which are service costs charged for building services.
The lessor must repair damage to the premises and attached facilities and pay the related expenses.
The lessor must repair the premises and attached facilities and pay the related expenses.
Party B has priority to buy the premises if Party A intends to sell them.
The clause addresses subleasing by Party B, requiring written consent to lease any part of the premises to a third party.
Allows the lessor to terminate the contract and take back the premises if specified tenant breaches occur.
Party B has priority to continue leasing the property over other parties under the same conditions.
Party A guarantees that the premises and attached facilities and equipment are in good condition.
It requires the tenant to return the premises and attached facilities and equipment when the lease ends.
It imposes a penalty when the lessee terminates the lease before its end without the lessor’s consent.
